rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing number of petals
adjective qualifying cakraṃ as having a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining form and structure of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject.
This cakra is characterized as royal.
This cakra has eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal wheel distinguished by eight petals and a central pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a descriptive epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
